title: Console handoff — quick log and TODO
content:
03/13 morning shift handoff (quickfire)

SUMMARY:
- Spike in dashboard 500s reported by multiple customers around 03/13 08:45-09:20 UTC. Errors concentrated on widget-render endpoint and some embed tiles.
- Customer ticket INF-2319 created, customer slack thread in #customer-success noted slow load + blank cards.
- Short-term workaround: force client-side refresh + toggle to lightweight tiles; pushed temporary flag (console.feature.experimental_light_tiles=true) for affected workspace.

TIMELINE / TRIAGE NOTES (quick):
- 08:44 UTC: Pager alert from SLOs -> spike in 5xx for /api/v1/widgets/render.
- 08:46 UTC: Observed increased p95 latency for console-api (service=console-api, route=/widgets/render) from 120ms to ~1.8s.
- 08:50 UTC: Error traces show NullPointer in rendering path -> downstream call to asset-fetcher intermittently returning 502.
- 08:55 UTC: Canary rollback of last console UI deploy (rev: ui-2026-03-12-7f) — no change.
- 09:05 UTC: Applied temporary flag to enable lightweight tiles for workspace: acme-corp (patched via admin console).
- 09:15 UTC: Customer informs blank cards fixed after manual refresh.
- 09:30 UTC: Mitigation accepted; escalated to eng-serving-runtime for deeper investigation.

REPRO STEPS (local):
1) Start local console with env: "FEATURE_LIGHT_TILES=false"
2) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <test-token>" "https://staging-console.redwood.ai/api/v1/widgets/render?workspace=acme-corp" -v
3) Observe headers: X-Downstream-Status shows 502 from asset-fetcher in failing cases
4) Re-run while toggling feature flag to true -> returns 200 and renders simplified JSON.

QUICK CHECKS TO RUN (next oncall) - prioritized:
- [ ] Query logs for 08:30-09:45 UTC: service:console-api route:/widgets/render status:5xx  -> ticket INF-2319
- [ ] Search traces to find first 502 from asset-fetcher; note host and region
- [ ] Hit staging endpoint with a repeatable failing widget payload (attached in linked artifacts)
- [ ] Check asset-fetcher SLO dashboard (infra -> asset-fetcher) for concurrent spikes
- [ ] Confirm no recent infra autoscaling events that coincide with 08:40-09:00
- [ ] If asset-fetcher unstable, fallback: increase cache TTL in CDN for critical assets (short rollout)

NOTES / HUNCHES:
- Root cause likely transient asset-fetcher overload or a bad content encoding causing downstream 502 responses. NullPointer in console code appears to be defensive code not handling missing asset metadata (we saw one stack trace referencing AssetMetadata.getMime()).
- Could be related to a recent image-optimization change in media pipeline (PR #412) — cross-reference with media team.

COMMUNICATIONS / WHO TO LOOP IN:
- Media team: @Maya Chen (already pinged) -> ask to review PR #412 and recent deploys to media pipeline.
- Serving/runtime: @Ethan Liu -> check for cluster-level pressure or kernel OOMs around 08:40-09:00.
- Customer Success: notified about workaround and follow-up planned.

ACTION ITEMS (short):
- [ ] Attach minimal failing payload to INF-2319 (I put sample JSON in ticket).
- [ ] Ask media team to roll back PR #412 on staging if they can reproduce.
- [ ] Prepare a short customer message template (CS) explaining mitigation and ETA for permanent fix.
- [ ] Schedule 1-hr sync with media + console + runtime (propose 03/13 15:00 UTC)

NOTES TO SELF (quick):
- Save console logs: logs/console/2026-03-13/08_44-09_30.tar.gz -> uploaded to S3 path: s3://redwood-debug/ashwin/inf-2319-logs
- Local commands I used:
  * curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d @payload.json https://staging-console.redwood.ai/api/v1/widgets/render -v
  * jq '.widgets[] | select(.id=="tile-7")' failing-response.json
- Remember to set follow_up label on INF-2319 to "post-mortem" if root cause confirmed.

Handoff summary for next person picking this up:
- Mitigation applied (lightweight tiles flag) and customers reporting improvement after refresh.
- Primary suspect: media pipeline change PR #412 causing asset-fetcher 502s -> needs media team investigation and possible rollback.
- Oncall next steps: verify asset-fetcher health, attach traces to INF-2319, coordinate rollback if reproduced.

END NOTES / QUICK CAPSULE:
- If you pick this up: check asset-fetcher hosts in region us-west-2 first, look for JVM OOM or HTTP 502 patterns, and confirm whether a CDN cache TTL tweak helps while media team works on fix.
- Ping me in slack if you need the exact sample payload or the S3 logs (I left perms open for eng-observability team).

-- Ashwin

(rough; meant to be a fast handoff doc, keep editing and add findings inline)
